notes: Changes are left uncommitted in the worktree on branch bridgie-task/statement-review/T01. Decisions: (1) DEFAULT_RULESET is v1 and RULESETS is ('v1',) because v2 does not exist yet; the design makes v2 the default in step 2 (a later task), which should add v2.yaml to RULESETS and change DEFAULT_RULESET. The P7 tests pin CMA_RULESET=v1 explicitly, so they stay valid after that switch. (2) The loader follows policy.py: a packaged package (cma.rules) read via importlib.resources, sha256 of the file text, errors collected and raised as RulesetError (a ValueError). Only ids in RULESETS load, so CMA_RULESET cannot point at a path. Every rule has an id now, ready for 'which rule set the category' in C1. (3) The matching passes (link_reversals, unmark_round_trips, counterparty) stay in code as the design says. INVOICE_REF stays a code constant because counterparty() and importers/monzo.py use it; v1.yaml repeats the same regex text for its invoice rule (a deliberate small duplication; P7 would catch drift). NON_TRADING_IN and RULES were module constants with no other users (rg over src and tests) and are removed. (4) R54's 'record v1 in every evidence record': graph.py's categorise node now stores {id, sha256} in a new MemoState key 'ruleset', and evidence_record writes it under 'ruleset' (additive; s.get so old checkpoints resume and give null). No new type enters graph state, so CHECKPOINT_TYPES is unchanged. Case-store evidence (evidence JSON v1, schema_version) is later work. (5) The P7 golden compares M1-M16 by id, unit, value and a sha256 of the evidence id list, not by name, because M16 is renamed in a later task (R10). It is gzipped (40 KB; 406 KB uncompressed) to keep diff packets small; read it with zcat. Its synthetic entries also pin the generator's CSV sha256, so generator drift is reported as such, not as a ruleset change. The capture plugin and builder script are in the run directory (capture_plugin.py, make_p7_baseline.py); they must not be rerun on newer code. (6) committed examples (memo.md, evidence.json, truth.json) were not touched: nothing in T01 changes their figures, and their regeneration belongs to the M16 rename / v2 tasks.
